title: KugelAudio Recognizer Options
description: KugelAudio streaming STT (kugel-ear-1) options. Only applies when recognizer vendor is 'kugelaudio'. KugelAudio detects the end of each turn itself: words stream as interim results when interim is enabled, and a final transcript closes the turn; in the agent verb each final ends the user's turn. Supported languages: cs, da, de, el, en, es, fi, fr, hu, it, nl, pl, pt, ro, sv (the recognizer language is reduced to its base code, e.g. de-DE to de); any other language uses KugelAudio's automatic detection.

apiKey.description: KugelAudio API key. Overrides the key configured in jambonz. The key needs the speech-to-text permission.

model.description: STT model. Defaults to kugel-ear-1, currently the only model.

languages.description: Languages to detect among, in order of likelihood (e.g. ['de', 'en']). Replaces the recognizer language. Unsupported codes are dropped.

turnDetection.description: How a turn ends. 'kugelturn' (default) is KugelAudio's semantic end-of-turn model, which can close a turn after a pause of about 200 ms. 'vad' ends a turn after 1 s of silence.

turnDetectionLevel.description: How eagerly kugelturn ends a turn. 'responsive' (default) or 'conservative', which waits longer before ending a turn. Not sent with turnDetection 'vad', which KugelAudio would reject.

boostedPhrases.description: Words or phrases to favor (names, brands, jargon), up to 64 characters each. When omitted, recognizer.hints are used.

dictionaryIds.description: Ids of KugelAudio dictionaries that bias recognition. An id unknown to the key's project fails the session.

projectId.description: KugelAudio project the session is billed to.

kugelaudioSttUri.description: Custom host to connect to instead of api.kugelaudio.com, e.g. api.eu.kugelaudio.com for EU processing, or a proxy. Defaults to the host of the credential's API URL.

kugelaudioSttUseTls.description: Use TLS when connecting to a custom host. Default true.
